status: Stage validated; no runtime integration or full-model performance claim yet.
hardware: RyzenAI-npu6 AIE2P, Ryzen AI 7 H 350; XRT 2.25.00; firmware 1.0.0.63
design: Eight projection workers reuse each BF16 weight tile for both tokens, eight residual workers preserve FP32 output and addition ordering. Two residual input groups each fan out through a MemTile to four workers.
compilation_findings: Eight independent residual inputs plus weight/input streams exhaust Shim DMA capacity.
A single residual stream splitting to eight outputs exceeds per-MemTile DMA capacity.
Two residual groups with four outputs each compile successfully.

validation.bitwise: Both token projections and residual outputs match existing single-token kernel.
validation.order: single pair / batch / batch / single pair

limitations: Contiguous test inputs only; resident recurrence and residual views need strided gather support before integration.
No accepted whole-model speedup; baseline production artifacts unchanged.
